items.title: Scope
items.text: These docs are based on the current codebase in src/, public/, and root configuration files.

items.title: Purpose
items.text:
CipherPortfolio is the official portfolio website for Cipher Unit.

It presents:

  • brand identity
  • highlighted project(s)
  • technical skills
  • contact channels

items.title: High-Level Features
items.text:
• responsive landing page sections
  • dedicated contact page (/contact)
  • external redirect page to GitHub (/github)
  • custom 404 page
  • SEO metadata + sitemap + robots

items.title: Directory Summary
items.text:
• src/app → routes, layout, metadata, sitemap
  • src/components → UI and section-level components
  • public → static images and robots.txt

items.title: Rendering Model
items.text:
• App Router is used via src/app.
  • Root layout wraps all routes with shared chrome.
  • Most components are server components by default.
  • Interactive components use "use client" when needed.

items.title: /github
items.text:
File: src/app/github/page.tsx

Behavior:

  • sets route metadata
  • redirects user to GitHub profile URL

items.title: Not Found
items.text:
File: src/app/not-found.tsx

Custom 404 page with a CTA back to /.

items.title: Section Components
items.text:
• src/components/hero/Hero.tsx
  • headline, intro text, primary contact CTA
  • src/components/overview/Overview.tsx
  • quick stats row
  • src/components/projects/components/Projects.tsx
  • projects section shell and project list
  • src/components/projects/components/ProjectBox.tsx
  • single project card rendering
  • src/components/skils/Skils.tsx
  • skills section layout and grouped skill boxes
  • src/components/about-me/AboutMe.tsx
  • about section + secondary CTA
  • src/components/contacts/LandingContact.tsx
  • compact contact teaser for homepage

items.title: Shared Components
items.text:
• src/components/shared/header/*
  • responsive navigation and mobile menu
  • src/components/shared/footer/Footer.tsx
  • bottom media links + footer text
  • src/components/shared/Button.tsx
  • themed button variants (primary, stroke)
  • src/components/shared/Fields.tsx
  • reusable section title line
  • src/components/shared/NamePage.tsx
  • route-based section heading
  • src/components/shared/ImageLogo.tsx
  • brand logo + link to home

items.title: Environment Variables
items.text:
Example keys used in docs and UI:

  • CONTACT_EMAIL
  • GITHUB_API_BASE_URL
  • GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN

Set them in .env.local for local development.

items.title: Global Metadata
items.text:
File: src/app/layout.tsx

Configured SEO items:

  • metadataBase
  • title template
  • description + keywords
  • Open Graph
  • Twitter card
  • robots directives
  • canonical/alternates
  • app metadata (icons, apple web app, format detection)

items.title: Robots
items.text:
File: public/robots.txt

Controls crawler behavior at the site root.

items.title: Content Typos
items.text: Some visible strings appear to contain typos (for example in labels and paragraph text). These are currently documented as-is and can be corrected in a dedicated content pass.

items.title: GitHub URL Inconsistency
items.text:
• Several places use https://github.com/cipherunits/
  • Redirect route currently points to https://github.com/cipherunit

Unifying this value in one config source can reduce drift.

items.title: Repeated Contact Email Source
items.text: CONTACT_EMAIL is rendered in multiple components directly from environment variables. A shared config module can centralize this.

items.title: Existing README vs Docs
items.text: Root README.md already has onboarding information. The docs/ folder now provides sectioned, maintainable internal documentation.
